author: Aichavdk

title: One of my favourite apps!
body: This app really keeps me focused on what is important for me. With the free version you can create 3 habits. With the paid version (1x €9.99) you can create unlimited habits. For me, the paid version is more than worth the price. The user experience and design is easy to understand, the options are almost unlimited and I can see reports of how I managed to succeed my habits in the past. A must-have app for productive people. The only comment I can make is that the colours for the habits could be expanded so that people with a lot of habits can choose one individual colour for every single habit. All together a great app.
author: DieGozer97

title: User friendly habit tracker
body: This app is amazing. It has the most user friendly interface of any habit tracker I have tried out (I have tried 6 different ones). I will tell you now: the app is not free. It will cost you 10 buck for a lifetime purchase. To me, that is a great price. Nowadays everybody tries to put up subscription models, which I am no fan of. What I love most about the app is that you can have daily, weekly, monthly goals without the need to restrict yourself to what days you performed the habits on. It also shows a progress percentage for that week on tasks that you want to perform multiple times per week. The widget is even better, since you can keep track of habits without needing to open the app.

author: V.Looten

title: Needs improvement
body: Solid app, but needs improvement. For example, notifications that you set come regardless of whether you’ve completed a task. No need to remind me for something that I’ve already done and logged. Also, the design seems to be primary focus, at the ellende of clear understanding and efficient interaction. Too often, you need to tap and swipe multiple times to do something. Furthermore, habits that are done in units of 1 work fine, but if you f.e. want to eat 100 grams of fish each week, and you just ate 65 grams, it’s really cumbersome to have to tap 65 times.
author: sweetpeppadew

title: Pretty neat but doesn’t work!
body:
For me. It’s very frustrating, coz this app seems perfect, except for one important feature. 

To stay motivated, I need to be able to see my progress in a monthly calendar and be able to switch habits in these calendars... and that’s not possible. 

I asked about this and got the standard “yeah thanks for your suggestion we’ll see what we can do etc” after which I never heard anything anymore, of course. Like they care. 

So I tried going on without this option but I soon gave up and am now looking for a better app. Which is a shame. The one star is for how it looks. Had they added the feature to switch in calendars, it would certainly be 5 stars, as this makes the difference between staying motivated and not, which is what this app should be about.
